facts.fact: Eden 穿着他行李里「失踪」的那件毛衣——Ben 与 Michelle 当场看破没说破。
facts.anchor: The jumper that just so happened to be missing from my bag after the mid-semester break.

facts.fact: Michelle 回国突袭：已私自邀请 Eden 来看 Ben 的 footy 比赛——「见面认识一下」。
Macie 现身：自称「比朋友更多」——初恋、手搭 bicep、对 Eden 冷嘲「真遗憾结局」。
facts.anchor: We’re more than friends, silly. I was his first girlfriend!

facts.fact: Michelle 的敌意有据：曾威胁扯掉 Macie 的假发片——「她做了那种事」。
facts.anchor: She knew full well I’d rip out her fucking hair extensions for what she did

facts.fact: 对 Eden 的第一版交代：高中交往几个月、结局不愉快——「我只想说这么多」。
facts.anchor: Macie and I dated in high school. Just for a few months. And it didn’t end nicely.

facts.fact: Ben 现效力 Devils（三年前转会）并打进制胜球；Macie 连这都不记得。
facts.anchor: She doesn’t even care enough to remember Ben moved to the Devils three years ago.

facts.fact: 派对坦白核心：那晚他醉得不省人事，她把手伸进他裤子——还「失望于发现的东西」。
facts.anchor: She shoved her hands down my pants, and was…disappointed with what she found

facts.fact: 「我醉到推不开她」——事后她向所有人嘲笑他「不行」。
facts.anchor: I was too drunk to get her off me.

facts.fact: 沉默的原因：她是学校的 top dog，他是「呆瓜玩物」——知情者只有 Ben 与 Michelle。
facts.anchor: She was the top dog at our school, and I was just her dorky plaything.

facts.fact: Eden 的回应：它发生在你身上、它至今影响你——「我该当场撕了她」。
facts.anchor: But it still happened to you. And it still affects you.

facts.fact: 「你告诉了我，我就有机会更懂你」——坦白把两人推过友达线。
facts.anchor: It gives me a chance to understand you better.
